description: This file is an HTML document that implements a self-contained, minimal quiz frontend. It includes inline CSS styles and a JavaScript block managing quiz data, rendering questions, handling user interactions, validation, scoring, timing, and UI updates.

methods.name: renderQuiz
methods.description: Renders the quiz questions with shuffled options based on the current question order.

methods.name: getSelectedAnswers
methods.description: Retrieves the selected answer for each question from the form inputs.

methods.name: computeScore
methods.description: Calculates the user's score and identifies missed questions based on current answers.

methods.name: renderResults
methods.description: Displays the final score and missed questions review in the results section.

methods.name: validateAllAnswered
methods.description: Checks whether all questions have been answered before submission.

methods.name: applyGrading
methods.description: Applies visual indicators marking correct and incorrect answers after submission.

methods.name: resetQuizUi
methods.description: Resets the quiz interface to its initial state, optionally re-randomizing question order.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Displays a message to the user with optional styling for error or success states.
